# `like`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns true if str matches `pattern` with `escape`, null if any arguments are null, false otherwise.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
str like pattern[ ESCAPE escape]
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `predicate_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- like, example 1
> SELECT like('Spark', '_park');
true
```

```sql
-- like, example 2
> SELECT '\\abc' AS S, S like r'\\abc', S like '\\\\abc';
\abc | true | true
```

```sql
-- like, example 3
> SET spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals=true;
spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals | true
```

```sql
-- like, example 4
> SELECT '%SystemDrive%\Users\John' like '\%SystemDrive\%\\Users%';
Error: INVALID_FORMAT.ESC_IN_THE_MIDDLE
```

```sql
-- like, example 5
> SET spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals=false;
spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals | false
```

```sql
-- like, example 6
> SELECT '%SystemDrive%\\Users\\John' like r'%SystemDrive%\\Users%';
true
```

```sql
-- like, example 7
> SELECT '%SystemDrive%/Users/John' like '/%SystemDrive/%//Users%' ESCAPE '/';
true
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
